passages.text: This is the burden against Moab: Ar in Moab is ruined, destroyed in a night! Kir in Moab is devastated, destroyed in a night!
passages.sermon:
This message is a prophecy against Moab.
God speaks about Moab.
Ar is a city in Moab.
Ar is ruined.
Ar is destroyed in one night.
Kir is another city in Moab.
Kir is devastated.
Kir is destroyed in one night.
passages.original: מַשָּׂ֖א מוֹאָ֑ב כִּ֠י בְּלֵ֞יל שֻׁדַּ֨ד עָ֤ר מוֹאָב֙ נִדְמָ֔ה כִּ֗י בְּלֵ֛יל שֻׁדַּ֥ד קִיר־ מוֹאָ֖ב נִדְמָֽה׃

passages.text: Dibon goes up to its temple to weep at its high places. Moab wails over Nebo, as well as over Medeba. Every head is shaved, every beard is cut off.
passages.sermon:
Dibon is a city in Moab.
The people of Dibon go up to their temple.
They go to the high places to weep.
Moab mourns over Nebo.
Moab also mourns over Medeba.
Every person shaves his head.
Every man cuts off his beard.
passages.original: עָלָ֨ה הַבַּ֧יִת וְדִיבֹ֛ן הַבָּמ֖וֹת לְבֶ֑כִי עַל־ נְב֞וֹ וְעַ֤ל מֵֽידְבָא֙ מוֹאָ֣ב יְיֵלִ֔יל בְּכָל־ רֹאשָׁ֣יו קָרְחָ֔ה כָּל־ זָקָ֖ן גְּרוּעָֽה׃

passages.text: In its streets they wear sackcloth; on the rooftops and in the public squares they all wail, falling down weeping.
passages.sermon:
The people of Moab suffer.
They walk in the streets.
They wear sackcloth.
They go up on the rooftops.
They gather in the public squares.
Everyone wails loudly.
They fall down and weep.
passages.original: בְּחוּצֹתָ֖יו חָ֣גְרוּ שָׂ֑ק עַ֣ל גַּגּוֹתֶ֧יהָ וּבִרְחֹבֹתֶ֛יהָ כֻּלֹּ֥ה יְיֵלִ֖יל יֹרֵ֥ד בַּבֶּֽכִי׃

passages.text: Heshbon and Elealeh cry out; their voices are heard as far as Jahaz. Therefore the soldiers of Moab cry out; their souls tremble within.
passages.sermon:
Heshbon cries out.
Elealeh cries out.
People hear their voices as far as Jahaz.
The soldiers of Moab cry out.
Their souls tremble inside them.
passages.original: וַתִּזְעַ֤ק חֶשְׁבּוֹן֙ וְאֶלְעָלֵ֔ה עַד־ יַ֖הַץ נִשְׁמַ֣ע קוֹלָ֑ם עַל־ כֵּ֗ן חֲלֻצֵ֤י מוֹאָב֙ יָרִ֔יעוּ נַפְשׁ֖וֹ יָ֥רְעָה לּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: My heart cries out over Moab; her fugitives flee as far as Zoar, as far as Eglath-shelishiyah. With weeping they ascend the slope of Luhith; they lament their destruction on the road to Horonaim.
passages.sermon:
The prophet Isaiah speaks in this passage.
Isaiah feels deep sorrow for Moab.
His heart cries out for the people of Moab.
The people of Moab are fleeing.
The fugitives run as far as Zoar.
They also run as far as Eglath-shelishiyah.
They climb the slope of Luhith.
They weep as they go up.
On the road to Horonaim, they cry out in grief.
They mourn their destruction.
passages.original: לִבִּי֙ לְמוֹאָ֣ב יִזְעָ֔ק בְּרִיחֶ֕הָ עַד־ צֹ֖עַר עֶגְלַ֣ת שְׁלִשִׁיָּ֑ה כִּ֣י׀ מַעֲלֵ֣ה הַלּוּחִ֗ית בִּבְכִי֙ יַֽעֲלֶה־ בּ֔וֹ כִּ֚י דֶּ֣רֶךְ חוֹרֹנַ֔יִם זַעֲקַת־ שֶׁ֖בֶר יְעֹעֵֽרוּ׃

passages.text: The waters of Nimrim are dried up, and the grass is withered; the vegetation is gone, and the greenery is no more.
passages.sermon:
The waters of Nimrim are dried up.
The grass is withered.
All the vegetation is gone.
There is no more greenery.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ מֵ֥י נִמְרִ֖ים מְשַׁמּ֣וֹת יִֽהְי֑וּ כִּֽי־ יָבֵ֤שׁ חָצִיר֙ כָּ֣לָה דֶ֔שֶׁא יֶ֖רֶק לֹ֥א הָיָֽה׃

passages.text: So they carry their wealth and belongings over the Brook of the Willows.
passages.sermon:
The people of Moab gather their wealth.
They collect their belongings.
They carry these things with them.
They cross over the Brook of the Willows with their possessions.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֖ן יִתְרָ֣ה עָשָׂ֑ה וּפְקֻדָּתָ֔ם עַ֛ל נַ֥חַל הָעֲרָבִ֖ים יִשָּׂאֽוּם׃

passages.text: For their outcry echoes to the border of Moab. Their wailing reaches Eglaim; it is heard in Beer-elim.
passages.sermon:
The people of Moab cry out loudly.
Their outcry spreads everywhere in Moab.
Their wailing reaches as far as Eglaim.
People also hear their wailing in Beer-elim.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הִקִּ֥יפָה הַזְּעָקָ֖ה אֶת־ גְּב֣וּל מוֹאָ֑ב עַד־ אֶגְלַ֙יִם֙ יִלְלָתָ֔הּ וּבְאֵ֥ר אֵילִ֖ים יִלְלָתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: The waters of Dimon are full of blood, but I will bring more upon Dimon— a lion upon the fugitives of Moab and upon the remnant of the land.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Dimon.
The waters of Dimon are full of blood.
God will bring more trouble upon Dimon.
God will send a lion against the fugitives of Moab.
God will send a lion against the remnant of the land.
passages.original: כִּ֣י מֵ֤י דִימוֹן֙ מָ֣לְאוּ דָ֔ם כִּֽי־ אָשִׁ֥ית עַל־ דִּימ֖וֹן נוֹסָפ֑וֹת לִפְלֵיטַ֤ת מוֹאָב֙ אַרְיֵ֔ה וְלִשְׁאֵרִ֖ית אֲדָמָֽה׃
